label: 8.34-portable-qualified
primaryMetric: Last origin body send to actual exit time of all observed current-session application processes, using GetProcessTimes; hashes and final catalog checked after exit. Includes app-owned background work and /q shutdown, not GUI timing or system services.
idmExitStatusInterpretation: All nine IDM launchers returned 1, matching earlier retained runs; no independently verified IDM exit-code contract is assumed. Actual exit, file availability, complete length and independent digest are separate observed checks.
limits: All original pairs, including losses, retained. No unchanged-build rerun seeks a passing score.
Actual application process exit includes observed app-owned work and /q shutdown; the separate symmetric output flush is not a measurement of every system service or GUI completion animation.
Portable C: comparison, not an installed or D: verification. Cache/device/profile/background conditions remain confounds; no code-only causal speedup or universal guarantee.
